exposure: severity of endometriosis (stage I/II vs. III/IV)
Stage I/II endometriosis vs stage III/IV endometriosis
outcome: Other pregnancy complications (chronic hypertension, HELLP syndrome, GDM, PGDM, ICP, premature rupture of membranes, placental abruption)
cohort: 3,809 parturients, including 1,026 with endometriosis and 2,783 without
finding: Endometriosis was associated with an increased incidence of placenta previa, preeclampsia, and postpartum hemorrhage.
